branch_purpose: Source-reported finite operator constructions and one exact weak-live-table counterexample. A common question-independent reference POVM with full-input Loewner radii gives a complete all-input event/live-law preserving filter; clipping and moment criteria yield conditional routes only under their stated event, selected-history and commuting-density premises. For complete local binary success/fine/failure instruments, the weighted CHSH inequality gives max(G_A,G_B)>=sqrt(2)p(1-2 alpha_CHSH). A legal two-round source game of value one embeds a perfect PR live bit table with p0=(1+1/sqrt(2))/2, forcing max mass >=(1+sqrt(2))/2>1 for exact live-table replacement.

assumptions: The common-reference route assumes question-independent reference POVMs dominating all full-input coarse effects in Loewner order.
The clipping and moment routes retain their stated full-rank, event, accepted-stack, greedy-history and source-composition premises.
The exact mass counterexample assumes complete local success/fine/failure POVMs with arbitrary shared resources and preserves the exact original live table.
